jobs.title: Automation Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA's Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation's skies safe and connected. We're looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world's most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won't just support the mission - you'll define it.

Peraton is seeking an experienced Automation Program Manager
to support a Automation workstream NEEDS package execution, oversight, and growth of large-scale IT programs aligned to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) most significant modernization initiatives supporting the National Airspace System (NAS). This role partners closely with the Program Director to manage daily operations, technical delivery, workforce performance, and stakeholder engagement for a diverse team of 100+ IT professionals spanning Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, System Software Testing and Cloud.

The ideal candidate is a proven leader with strong operational discipline, financial acumen, and experience delivering complex IT services in a regulated federal environment.

Work Location:

Remote work is permitted; candidates must reside within the contiguous United States.

Your Impact:

This Director-Level leadership role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into successful operational execution while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, technical excellence, workforce performance, financial stewardship, and program growth. You will lead cross-functional workstreams, partner directly with Peraton and FAA leadership, and drive successful delivery across multiple complex modernization initiatives.

Strategic Program Leadership

Serve as Program Manager providing leadership across all operational and technical aspects of the workstream.
Translate strategic program objectives into executable operational plans.
Oversee end-to-end execution of NEEDS Package activities.
Ensure successful delivery of all contractual requirements while maintaining cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives.

Operational Leadership

Lead day-to-day operations supporting a workforce of 100+ Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, System Software Testing and Cloud professionals.
Partner with functional managers to optimize resource allocation across multiple programs and priorities.
Lead cross-functional planning efforts.

Technical Program Execution

Direct execution of large, complex engineering and technology initiatives from planning through deployment and operational transition.
Manage scope, schedule, technical baselines, dependencies, and integration activities across multiple engineering disciplines.
Lead technical reviews, milestone assessments, operational readiness reviews, and executive decision forums.

Financial & Business Management (P&L Responsibility)

Assist the Workstream Lead with Profit and Loss (P&L) management for a multi-million-dollar portfolio, ensuring financial performance aligns with business objectives.
Support development and execution of annual operating plans, budgets, labor forecasts, indirect planning, and revenue projections.
Monitor program financial health, including revenue, margin, labor utilization, backlog, burn rates, and cost performance.
Identify opportunities to improve profitability through operational efficiencies, workforce optimization, and continuous improvement.
Partner with Contracts, Finance, Program Controls, and Business Operations to manage budgets, forecasts and financial reporting.
Support business growth through proposal development, capture activities, staffing strategies, and transition planning.

Customer Engagement

Develop trusted relationships with FAA leaders, Peraton executives, and key stakeholders.
Lead executive program reviews, customer briefings, milestone reviews, and operational governance meetings.
Ensure customer priorities remain aligned with program execution.
Represent Peraton during executive-level meetings and strategic planning sessions.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

Lead enterprise risk management activities across operational, technical, financial, and schedule performance.
Drive quality assurance, operational governance, and continuous service improvement.
Resolve complex technical, organizational, staffing, and customer issues.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

U.S. Citizenship Required.
Must have an active FAA Public Trust clearance.
16 years of experience managing large federal IT programs of 100+ personnel.
Proven success managing and delivering federal IT programs with annual budgets exceeding $100M+.
Experience managing Profit and Loss (P&L) for large federal programs, including budget planning, revenue forecasting, labor management, cost control, revenue, margin performance, and financial reporting.
Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, technical performance and budgets using structured project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
Hands-on experience with risk identification, mitigation, and issue resolution.
Ability to lead geographically dispersed, cross-functional programs.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience briefing senior leadership and external customers.
Demonstrated workforce planning, resource allocation and workload-management experience.
Demonstrated success delivering IT services delivery models, operational governance or systems in federal or highly regulated environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
Certifications such as PMP, ITIL Managing Professional, or SAFe Agilist.
Experience supporting FAA, DOT, or other aviation or transportation programs.
Familiarity with NextGen, large-scale modernization, or safety-critical systems.
Background in change management, organizational transformation, or program turnarounds.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, mentor, and retain high-performing teams.

#BNATCS

Details

Target Salary Range: $146,000 - $234,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:
Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Merchandising Presentation
jobs.description:
Description

Do you like solving data problems that have a real impact on how products get to store shelves? The Merchandising Presentation team in Amazon's World Wide Grocery organization is hiring a Program Manager to own the item data lifecycle behind our space planning and planogram (POG) production. The team is ramping up system integrations with internal partners, and this role is right in the middle of that work — helping build new capabilities that matter across the business. You will manage product and item data flowing into and out of our space planning tool, making sure it is accurate and reliable for every downstream consumer. You will also work with merchandising, tech, and vendor teams to set data standards, fix quality issues, and keep POG production on track as we grow.

Key job responsibilities

Own the item data program end to end — mapping, validating, and reconciling data across the systems that feed into and out of the space planning tool.
Work with merchant teams, Merchandising Presentation Planners, engineering, and vendors to nail down data requirements, collect feedback, and set integration standards.
Turn complex data flows into clear documentation, project charters, and status updates so stakeholders and leadership always know where things stand.
Find and roll out process improvements that help item data management scale across reset rounds and merchandising cycles, clearing blockers along the way.
Track project milestones, dependencies, and risks, and help cross-functional partners get aligned on what matters most.

A day in the life

Most mornings you will check data quality dashboards and triage any discrepancies before they affect upcoming resets. Over the course of the month you will connect with merchant partners to understand changing product assortments, collect feedback from Merchandising Presentation Planners on data gaps, and coordinate with engineering on integration work. Some days are heads-down in the item library; others are spent in working sessions getting teams on the same page about priorities and timelines. Weekly team syncs round things out — a chance to share updates and spot new partnership opportunities.

About The Team

The Merchandising Presentation team makes sure every store planogram is built on accurate, complete item data so products land on shelves exactly as planned. We are investing in deeper system integrations that open up new capabilities across World Wide Grocery, and it is a great time to get involved. Our team runs on collaboration and genuine investment in each person's growth. You will have biweekly career-development conversations with your manager, weekly team syncs to explore cross-functional projects, and encouragement to build mentorship connections outside the immediate team so you stay plugged into the bigger picture at Amazon.

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of program or project management experience
2+ years of industry work experience
3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of SQL
Experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience using Microsoft Projects software
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

In the role of Program Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client's specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making. Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff. Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications. Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program's financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR's program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one [transportation/water/resources] infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client's site temporarily

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)
Familiar with the various tools used to manage large programs - PMIS, CMIS, scheduling, cost control, document management, risk management, asset management, dashboard analytics, etc.
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. The expected compensation range for this position depends upon skills, experience, education and geographical location. (Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. Temporary and part-time roles eligible for limited benefits.) {California}: $152,845 - $248,125 Primary Location:

jobs.title: Senior Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation, GREF – Design, Sustainability & Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team is seeking an innovative and experienced Sr Global Engineering Program Manager – Building Controls & Automation to lead the technical strategy, standards, and optimization of mechanical and Building Management Systems (BMS)/Controls across our global corporate office portfolio. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for a mechanical or controls engineering specialist. You will own the mechanical and building automation backbone (HVAC, central plant, BMS/BAS, sequences of operation, fault detection) for the global GREF portfolio, while partnering across the broader MEP disciplines.

The ideal candidate combines deep, demonstrable expertise in mechanical systems and building controls with strong leadership and strategic thinking. You are fluent in the language of open-protocol building automation — BACnet, Modbus, Niagara/Tridium — and you can read a sequence of operations, interrogate a controls submittal, and diagnose why a system is not performing. You will develop and execute global engineering initiatives that enhance workplace environments, improve operational efficiency, and advance sustainability goals, navigating complex stakeholder relationships and making data-driven decisions that balance innovation with cost-effectiveness at a global scale.

Key job responsibilities

Standards & specifications — Develop and maintain global controls/BMS and mechanical design standards, guidelines, and specifications — including sequences of operation, points lists, and naming/tagging conventions — for new construction and retrofits.
Automation architecture — Define open-protocol BMS architecture (BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus, Niagara/FOX, MQTT), network topology, and integration; partner with InfoSec and IT on OT network security and data governance.
Operations & maintenance — Lead operational guidelines and SOPs for mechanical systems, controls, and equipment.
Performance & FDD — Establish fault detection & diagnostics, trending, and analytics to drive optimization and energy efficiency across the portfolio.
Technical leadership — Provide SME support to regional teams on complex mechanical and controls issues, including commissioning, Test and Balance (TAB), and root-cause failure analysis.
Lifecycle & modernization — Develop strategies for equipment lifecycle management, preventive maintenance, and system modernization.
Sustainability — Advance corporate environmental goals through mechanical and BMS initiatives.
Technology & innovation — Evaluate and recommend new building systems, controls, and smart-building technologies.
Metrics & vendors — Set KPIs and track portfolio improvements; partner with procurement on equipment/controls-vendor standards, qualification, and performance.
Strategy & growth — Support due diligence for acquisitions and renovations, deliver technical training, and shape long-term strategy and capital planning.

About The Team

The GREF Global Engineering team drives continuous improvement for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems across Amazon's corporate office portfolio worldwide. We set design and construction standards, develop operations and maintenance guidelines, and shape long-term MEP strategy — balancing innovation, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness at global scale. Our team thrives on diverse expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and data-driven decision-making to deliver resilient, high-performing workplaces. We're looking for technical leaders who challenge the status quo and bring fresh perspectives to complex building system challenges.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
6+ years of experience in building systems engineering

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes
Professional Engineering (PE) license
Certifications such as LEED, PMP, CEM, and/or HBDP.
Deep hands-on experience with BMS/BAS platforms and open protocols — Tridium/Niagara (FOX), BACnet, Modbus — including programming, commissioning, and integration.
Experience with fault detection & diagnostics (FDD) and building analytics platforms (e.g., SkySpark) and using building data to drive optimization.
Experience with OT network architecture and building-systems cybersecurity/InfoSec coordination.
Experience directly related to the design or construction of commercial office buildings.
Experience managing engineering programs for large, global real estate portfolios.
International project experience.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe water is more than a resource, it's a shared responsibility. As part of our Water Business Group, you’ll help shape how communities manage water for generations to come. From delivering safe drinking water and treating wastewater responsibly to developing sustainable water supplies and protecting lives and property through flood control, your work will directly support public health, environmental sustainability, and infrastructure resilience. We bring together experts across disciplines to solve complex challenges with bold thinking and technical excellence. Whether you're modernizing aging systems or pioneering innovative approaches, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in people’s lives. This isn’t just a job, it's a chance to lead change, drive progress, and leave a lasting legacy.

In the role of Program Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client's specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making. Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff. Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications. Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. Monitor team performance and establish a robust QA/QC program to meet client expectations.
Monitor the program's financial performance against pre-established financial metrics and make adjustments as necessary to meet earnings and profitability targets and control losses.
Contribute to the growth of HDR's program management services by (1) building a long-term trusted advisory relationship with clients; (2) looking for opportunities to expand our services to address the needs of existing clients; (3) supporting the pursuit of new program contract opportunities; and (4) mentoring and training staff working on programs.
Perform other duties as needed

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Professional Engineering License
PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
PMI Program Management Professions (PgMP) certification
CMAA Certified Construction Manager (CCM) Certification
AICP Certification
Experience participating in the consultant or owner program management team of at least one [transportation/water/resources] infrastructure program(s) with a capital value of $350 million
Knowledgeable of other alternative delivery/contract models, such as public-private partnership (P3), design-build-finance-operate-maintain (DBFOM), and engineering procurement construction (EPC)
Experience working in an integrated fashion within a Program Management Office (PMO) comprised of consultant and client staff
Willingness to travel and, if needed, commute to a client's site temporarily

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Planning, Sciences, Business Administration, or a closely related field
Program management experience consistent with one of the following requirements:
A minimum of three (3) years of program management experience in a deputy role to the Program Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, with a cumulative capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of five (5) years of program management experience as a Project Manager or Project Controls Manager for the delivery of one or more programs, each with a capital value of $200 million or more, or;
A minimum of ten (10) years of project management experience as a Project Manager directing a multi-disciplinary team for the delivery of at least two (2) projects, each with a capital value of $50 million or more
Strong leadership skills with experience building a cohesive team culture and managing team members in various locations.
Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to client executives and in front of a large audience in a public setting
Management experience with the implementation of projects or programs using alternative and collaborative delivery methods, including design-build (DB), progressive design-build (PDB), and/or construction management at-risk (CMAR)
Familiar with the various tools used to manage large programs - PMIS, CMIS, scheduling, cost control, document management, risk management, asset management, dashboard analytics, etc.
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. jobs.description:
Description

Are you ready to shape the future of advertising at Amazon? As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you’ll stand at the intersection of innovation and execution, leading strategic initiatives that redefine how advertisers engage with audiences across display, audio, video, streaming TV, and devices.

You’ll own the technical and science roadmaps for Amazon’s Omni-Channel Advertising business, driving cross-org impact through generative AI and agentic capabilities. Your expertise will guide the delivery of scalable advertising solutions that unlock new revenue streams and empower advertisers to achieve their goals with unprecedented efficiency.

Collaborate with senior leadership, lead org-wide planning sessions, and sit at the table where decisions shape Amazon’s advertising strategy. If you’re passionate about driving innovation, mastering technical roadmaps, and delivering transformative advertising solutions, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact. Lead the technical strategy and delivery of transformative advertising solutions across Amazon’s device ecosystem, where your work will directly impact how advertisers connect with audiences at scale. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you'll own end-to-end program delivery, drive generative AI and agentic capabilities, and provide thought leadership across our organization's most strategic initiatives.

Key job responsibilities

Lead strategic technical roadmaps for Amazon's Omni-Channel Advertising business, owning the vision and execution of initiatives that span multiple business lines and drive organizational impact

Architect and deliver scalable advertising solutions across Amazon's device ecosystem by collaborating with engineering, product, and device teams to prototype, test, and deploy high-impact capabilities

Manage complete program lifecycles from design and implementation through documentation and measurement, breaking complex challenges into actionable projects and ensuring timely, measurable delivery

Drive technical strategy and risk management by balancing business priorities with technical feasibility, anticipating constraints, and applying data-driven approaches to mitigate risks and prioritize features

Build cross-functional partnerships with advertising infrastructure, device teams, legal, and finance to align roadmaps, secure resources, and communicate technical strategy to senior leadership and stakeholders

A day in the life

As a Principal Technical Program Manager on our team, you'll lead the technical planning, coordination, and architecture of multiple programs spanning our advertising businesses. Your days involve working alongside Program Managers, Product Managers, and engineering teams to navigate complex, highly-technical projects with significant visibility across Amazon. You'll collaborate with partners across the organization—from our advertising infrastructure teams to device teams—ensuring seamless execution and alignment on strategy and timelines. You'll manage the complete lifecycle of software initiatives, from design and implementation through documentation and measurement, delivering high-impact solutions that scale across our ecosystem.

About The Team

We are a team driving innovation in advertising across Amazon's Devices, Media & Entertainment, Grocery, and Omni-Channel businesses. Our vision centers on advancing generative AI and agentic capabilities to create more intelligent, responsive advertising experiences. We serve customers and advertisers by building scalable solutions that integrate seamlessly across Amazon's device ecosystem. Over the coming years, we're focused on expanding the sophistication and reach of our advertising programs, and we're looking for someone who can help lead that transformation. You'll work with talented engineers, product leaders, and technical strategists who are committed to solving complex problems and delivering results that matter. Joining our team means being part of a collaborative environment where your technical expertise and strategic thinking will directly influence how millions of people interact with advertising across Amazon.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience in architectural design or system design independent of an architect
Bachelor's degree in computer science or other related discipline

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

jobs.description:
Description

Posting Title:
Project Manager - Commercial

Reports To
: Director, Project Management

Location:
San Francisco, CA | Greater San Francisco Bay Area | Ability to travel within the Greater Bay Area

Salary Range:
$127,500 to $200,000

This position is eligible for the annual performance bonus plan.

This position primarily involves working on-site at the project location or in office. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on the role and project timeline.

Final determination of a successful candidate’s starting pay will vary based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, education and experience. The pay scale listed for this position is generally for candidates that meet the specified qualifications and requirements listed on this specific job description. We provide a competitive compensation package that recognizes your experience, credentials, and education alongside a robust benefits program to meet your needs. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets.

Who We Are

Since 1954, Cupertino Electric, Inc. (CEI) has been powered by people who’ve built a reputation for delivering high-profile, complex projects. Real, tangible things that alter the landscape and improve lives. And we've done it with integrity for more than 70 years. We’re problem solvers and innovation seekers. We’re team players and safety fanatics. And we're proud to be part of Quanta Services (PWR:NYSE), North America's largest employer of skilled craft labor. Because what we do is important, but how we do it is everything.

THE COMMERCIAL TEAM

Our strong project management teams, dedicated in-house engineering resources and skilled union field staff work together seamlessly to deliver commercial projects that are as innovative and unique as the clients who build them.

About The Role

As a Construction Project Manager at Cupertino Electric, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of construction projects and the successful management of a high-performing team. You will manage the planning, execution, and financial performance of your projects using business practices that are consistent with our company values – people, safety, integrity, innovation, and excellence.

Own the financial performance of the assigned project or project scopes, including cost control, forecasting, margin protection, and overall commercial success.
Coordinate and lead daily/weekly planning meetings with Superintendents, General Foremen, and Project Engineers to review progress, develop means and methods, assess staffing and equipment needs, and manage long-lead procurement and subcontractor sequencing.
Review estimates, drawings, and specifications to understand scope, validate budget assumptions, and determine resource needs, construction methodology, and schedule requirements.
Develop and maintain accurate monthly job cost updates for project or project scopes, including cost-to-complete assessments, budget reallocations, and contingency planning.
Create, review, negotiate, and approve change orders for project or project scopes with clients, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper scope alignment and financial recovery.
Plan, coordinate, and supervise the activities of both company crews and subcontractors to ensure work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project requirements.
Proactively identify risks related to design gaps, scope conflicts, procurement delays, constructability issues, workforce needs, schedule constraints, and site conditions.
Develop and implement mitigation strategies including resequencing work, clarifying scope, accelerating procurement, or escalating design issues early through formal channels.
Maintain a project risk register and conduct regular risk review meetings to ensure potential issues are tracked, owned, and acted upon before they impact cost or schedule.
Monitor leading indicators such as submittal timelines, cost variances, and long-lead equipment status to anticipate challenges and prevent downstream impacts.
Interpret and enforce contract requirements to ensure project execution aligns with all commercial, technical, and administrative obligations.
Resolve technical challenges and unforeseen field issues quickly and collaboratively to avoid schedule impacts or rework.
Serve as the subject matter expert for the project or assigned scopes, ensuring clarity of requirements, specifications, and contract obligations.
Communicate effectively and consistently with department leads, engineers, superintendents, stakeholders, and clients to maintain alignment and transparency.
Partner closely with the Production team to ensure Superintendents, General Foremen, and Foremen fully understand plans, specifications, and installation requirements so field execution matches client expectations.
Ensure all work is performed to the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity, supporting CEI’s safety culture and operational excellence.
Lead all project closeout activities, including punch list completion, documentation, O&M submittals, as-built verification, financial closeout, retention collection, and support for claims resolution.
Represent and model CEI’s culture and values, engaging in company initiatives, fostering positive working relationships, and contributing to organizational improvement and growth.

About You

You possess dynamic leadership and management skills to influence and drive positive outcomes. You have thorough knowledge of the estimating, project cost accounting, scheduling, procurement, productivity tracking, and reporting methods necessary to profitably complete electrical construction projects. You have experience with union workforces, labor rate calculations, and collective bargaining agreements. In addition to your technical knowledge, you have a history of successfully leading teams and are passionate about developing and growing employees to their full potential.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, supervisory and planning skills.
Thorough knowledge of all aspects of construction (technology, equipment, methods), union jurisdiction, labor agreements, and negotiations.
Strong business acumen.
Ability to manage projects and/or project scopes from $15M to $30M in monetary value.

Minimum Qualifications

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education:
High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree in Construction Management, Business, Engineering, or similar preferred.

Licensure/Certifications:
None required.

Experience:

Typically requires 5+ years of related experience managing Electrical Construction on Commercial or Industrial Projects and/or project scopes.
Typically requires 5+ years of management experience, including client interface and solicitation, planning and execution, project delivery, and staff supervision.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, supervisory and planning skills.
Thorough knowledge of all aspects of construction (technology, equipment, methods), union jurisdiction, labor agreements, and negotiations.
Strong business acumen.
Ability to manage projects and/or project scopes from approximately $15M to $30M in monetary value.

Driving Record:
Valid state-issued driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for sponsorship.

jobs.description:
Description

Shift Description: (M-F) DE0T0900

Department: ICQA

The Data Analyst role will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SOX requirements. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of different business models and the underlying analytics, and the ability to assimilate new methodologies and data sources. They will be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, be vocally self-critical, and with an ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. They recognize that the true measure of the work product is the business impact it has.

Since opening our virtual doors in 1995, Amazon has been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. Our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE
. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

Maintains a professional and positive attitude

Experience with timeline development and budget management required

jobs.title: Project Manager - Design
jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title:

Project Manager - Design

Position Location:

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States (Periodic travel for client meetings, design workshops, and project coordination required)

Job Summary

The Project Manager - Design is responsible for end-to-end delivery of assigned Building Automation System (BAS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design projects supporting mission-critical and hyperscale data center facilities as an MEP consultant.

This role owns project scope, schedule, financial performance, design coordination, risk management, and client communication from project kickoff through design development and construction administration. The Project Manager works closely with Smart Tech Contracting Control Systems engineers, client teams, architects, Engineers of Record, and consultant partners responsible for other portions of the MEP design. Primary clients for this role are architecture and engineering (AE) firms that deliver programs / projects direct to the owner, with Smart Tech Contracting engaged as their BAS/EPMS design subconsultant. Depending on the project, this role also interfaces with owners, general contractors, and controls contractors.

The Project Manager serves as the primary point of accountability for assigned projects and operates with a high degree of independence while aligning with departmental standards, processes, and leadership direction. This role is expected to anticipate risk, drive decisions, and protect design quality, schedule, client satisfaction, and margin.

Essential Functions

Design Project Execution & Delivery (45%)

Own planning, execution, and delivery of assigned BAS and EPMS design projects from kickoff through construction administration
Lead project initiation activities including scope review, contract requirements, project setup, deliverable schedules, staffing needs, and execution planning
Manage design milestones across applicable phases including concept design, SD, DD, IFP/IFC, bid support, and construction administration
Coordinate Smart Tech engineers and MEP consultant partners to ensure timely completion of deliverables
Track and coordinate design documentation including basis of design, sequences of operation, points and alarm lists, system architecture / riser diagrams, specifications, schedules, and integration requirements
Coordinate design reviews, page turns, interdisciplinary reviews, and QA/QC activities
Manage RFIs, submittal reviews, design clarifications, and other construction-administration activities within project scope
Identify scope gaps, design conflicts, and coordination issues and drive them to resolution while ensuring deliverables meet client standards, applicable codes, contract requirements, and departmental quality expectations
Support development of BAS/EPMS-specific input to Owner Project Requirements (OPR) and early space-planning / schematic design efforts in coordination with the AE’s basis of design
Represent Smart Tech Contracting at site visits, including existing-condition surveys and BAS/EPMS-related punch-list walkthroughs
Coordinate BAS/EPMS scope interfaces with other MEP subconsultants, electrical and mechanical engineers, and controls subcontractors as Smart Tech’s design-side point of contact
Coordinate resource and material forecasting for assigned design scope
Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional / functional testing, and BAS/EPMS project closeout activities during construction administration

Financial & Change Management (20%)

Own project budgets, forecasts, profitability, and financial performance
Monitor labor utilization, consultant costs, project burn, and remaining effort against budget
Maintain accurate project forecasts and communicate financial risks to leadership
Identify changes in scope and prepare additional-service proposals and change-order documentation
Support client negotiations related to scope, schedule, fees, and contract adjustments while protecting design quality and client satisfaction
Develop and maintain schedules of value / cost schedules to support client progress billing
Evaluate controls-subcontractor and vendor proposals during procurement and construction administration and provide award recommendations where applicable

Schedule & Risk Management (15%)

Develop and maintain project schedules aligned with client and overall MEP design milestones
Track design deliverables, dependencies, decisions, reviews, and approvals
Identify schedule, staffing, scope, technical, and commercial risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans
Coordinate resource needs with engineering and department leadership and escalate significant risks, client concerns, or delivery constraints as appropriate

Client & Stakeholder Management (15%)

Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact for assigned projects
Lead project meetings with clients, architects, MEP consultants, Engineers of Record, internal engineering teams, and other project stakeholders
Communicate project status, financial performance, schedule, risks, technical decisions, and action items clearly and professionally
Maintain strong working relationships with client teams and consultant partners to support successful delivery and repeat business
Promote Smart Tech Contracting’s BAS/EPMS design capabilities to AE firms, owners, and industry partners; support marketing materials and firm positioning within the design community
Identify and develop new project opportunities with existing AE and client relationships to support account growth
Support proposal development, project expansions, and additional-service opportunities and represent Smart Tech Contracting professionally as an MEP design consultant

Process Improvement & Administration (5%)

Maintain accurate project documentation, meeting minutes, action logs, schedules, forecasts, and status reports
Utilize Smartsheet and other project-management tools to provide transparency into project performance
Support departmental standards, templates, lessons learned, and best-practice libraries
Maintain project contract administration records; manage personal and project hours using company tools
Leverage AI and emerging technologies where appropriate to improve project planning, reporting, workflow efficiency, and consistency

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

Identify opportunities to apply AI-enabled tools and workflow automation across design documentation, forecasting, and quality processes for BAS/EPMS projects
Support adoption of Smart Tech Contracting’s SmartTech.ai platform and related tools to strengthen design readiness, QA/QC, and project controls
Collaborate with the Special Projects & Innovation (SPI) team to pilot and roll out emerging technologies that align with departmental standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity
Promote a culture of innovation and continuous improvement in the use of technology to optimize design delivery and scalability

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements

Working knowledge of MEP consulting and design-project delivery
Working knowledge of BAS/BMS and/or EPMS systems and their relationship to mechanical and electrical systems
Understanding of MEP design phases and construction-document development
Ability to coordinate technical design deliverables including sequences of operation, points / alarm lists, system diagrams, specifications, and integration requirements
Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, standards, submittals, and equipment data
Knowledge of mission-critical facility and data-center design requirements strongly preferred
Ability to manage multiple concurrent design projects, competing deadlines, and project stakeholders
Proven ability to manage project budgets, forecasts, profitability, scope changes, and change orders
Strong project scheduling, risk-management, organizational, and decision-making skills
Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills
Proficiency with MS Office Suite and project-management / design-collaboration platforms such as Smartsheet, Bluebeam, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360, or similar
Familiarity with Revit / BIM design workflows preferred
Ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, MEP consultants, clients, and construction teams
Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through strong communication, organization, self-motivation, proactiveness, and accountability
Ability to work under pressure and meet compressed design schedules
Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve project workflows and operational efficiency
Knowledge of MEP, fire alarm (FA), and fire protection (FP) trades and their interface with BAS/EPMS systems
Knowledge of Method of Procedure (MOP) development and critical-facility work-notification processes
Ability to follow company and site safety requirements

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working on a computer
Ability to move through offices, project sites, and facility environments as needed
Ability to occasionally lift or move items up to 25 pounds

Travel Requirements

Up to approximately 10% travel for client meetings, design workshops, project coordination, and occasional site visits
Domestic travel may be required; a valid REAL ID-compliant identification or passport is required for air travel
Travel may include transportation by car or plane depending on business needs

Education / Experience Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field preferred
Equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience may be considered
5+ years of project management, design management, or engineering-project delivery experience within MEP consulting, building automation, controls, or technically complex facilities
Demonstrated experience owning projects through multiple design phases
MEP consulting / design experience strongly preferred
BAS/BMS and/or EPMS project experience strongly preferred
Mission-critical or data-center design experience strongly preferred

Benefits

Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
Dental and vision plans
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
Paid parental leave after one year of employment

This customer-facing role coordinates telecom service orders and circuit implementations across multiple technologies. Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy and execution? Can you take a big growth ambition, break it into a clear operating rhythm, and keep a room full of sales, marketing, strategy, and analytics partners moving in the same direction? Do you get energized by helping build something new? If so, this might be the opportunity for you!

Autodesk Flow is our industry cloud for Media & Entertainment, connecting artists, productions, and studios from first frame to final pixel. Two of its fastest growing businesses are Flow Capture

, our AI-powered toolset that turns live-action footage into editable CG scenes and helps creators move from idea to final frame faster. Both sit at the center of how content is being made today, and both have a significant opportunity to scale.

To capture that opportunity, the Director of Sales, Flow is standing up two Cross-Functional Growth Teams, one dedicated to Flow Studio and one dedicated to Flow Capture. Each brings together partners from Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Analytics who share accountability for scaling these businesses. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager
to serve as the Sales Director's right hand in building and running these teams. You will help shape the operating model from the ground up, then own the program management that keeps both teams focused, aligned, and delivering.

In this role you will be at the center of it all, working closely with the Director and senior leaders across Go-To-Market, Product, Marketing, Sales, Strategy, and Business Analytics. You will use your analytical mindset and strong program leadership to bring structure, clear accountabilities, and decision ownership to the work, and you will keep stakeholders engaged with regular communication on progress, risks, and wins. This role reports to the Director of Sales, Flow.

Partner with the Director of Sales, Flow to stand up the Flow Studio and Flow Capture Growth Teams, helping define charters, roles and responsibilities, and decision rights

Translate the Director's growth strategy into executable plans with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures, and track progress against them

Build strong alliances and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and trust across every team you touch

Experience building new programs, teams, or operating models from the ground up
Proven experience leading go-to-market or revenue growth programs that span Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Analytics, including defining the plan, not just executing it
Experience partnering closely with a senior leader as a trusted advisor, chief of staff, or program lead
A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, a bias for action, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves

A consummate planner who stays cool and calm in high-stakes situations and thrives at taming complexity
Demonstrated executive presence and exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Impact

Leonardo UK is seeking a hands-on Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex infrastructure and technology change within the Cyber Security Division. Working in a lean Integrated Project Team, you will combine senior delivery leadership with direct ownership of the plans, controls, requirements, verification, test and acceptance products required to deliver successfully.

You will manage multiple concurrent and interdependent changes for defence and wider government customers. The portfolio principally covers infrastructure and platform change, including software and operating-system upgrades, new application integration, cyber-security change, migration, transition and operational readiness.

The role requires resilience, sound judgement and strong negotiation skills, together with the confidence to challenge constructively while maintaining effective customer relationships.

The role is based at the customer site in London. There will be some flexibility to work from home, however, frequent site presence is required.

Security clearance is a requirement for this role. If you already hold an appropriate clearance, this would be beneficial.

What You Will Do As a Senior Project Manager

Lead projects and changes across the full lifecycle, from mobilisation and definition through implementation, verification, acceptance, transition and closure.
Operate as a hands-on delivery leader as well as a manager. Personally produce, populate, review and maintain core project artefacts as required within a delivery environment.
Establish and maintain integrated project schedules, delivery baselines, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, forecasts and credible recovery plans.
Develop and maintain Project Management Plans, RAID logs, decision and assumption records, resource forecasts, governance packs, progress reports and auditable delivery records.
Manage several concurrent deliveries, balancing competing priorities, specialist resources, operational demands and contractual milestones.
Identify cumulative risk and cross-project dependencies, resolve priority conflicts where possible, and escalate with clear evidence, options and recommendations.
Lead multidisciplinary teams across engineering, architecture, security, test and service management. Work collaboratively with Finance, Commercial, suppliers and customer organisations.
Integrate security, accreditation and assurance activities into delivery plans. Coordinate the associated evidence, reviews, approvals, access constraints and security-cleared resource dependencies.

Requirements, verification, test and acceptance

Translate contractual, customer and business needs into controlled, measurable delivery outcomes and acceptance criteria.
Develop and maintain requirements catalogues, where required, and end-to-end traceability from requirement through design, implementation, verification and acceptance.
Drive completion of Verification and Validation Requirements Matrices, working directly with the team to populate, maintain and update them. Identify unclear, conflicting, unallocated or untestable requirements and drive their timely resolution.
Coordinate the creation and review of test strategies, plans, specifications, scripts and readiness evidence. Contribute directly to these products and associated test outputs where necessary.
Develop and maintain Integrated Test, Evaluation and Acceptance Plans and associated evidence matrices, records and acceptance submissions.
Plan and control integration, verification, validation, transition and customer acceptance activity. Ensure the supporting evidence is complete, coherent, configuration-controlled and suitable for approval.
Drive defect, concession and acceptance-action resolution with technical specialists, suppliers and customers.

Commercial, financial and governance responsibilities

Deliver against the contract, statement of work, agreed baselines, milestones and acceptance criteria. Maintain a clear distinction between contractual obligations, customer expectations and emerging requests.
Control project scope, requirements, assumptions and change. Produce robust impact assessments covering cost, schedule, resources, risk, security, test, acceptance and contractual commitments.
Recognise out-of-scope activity and engage Commercial before commitments are made. Support contract change, negotiation and commercial correspondence while protecting Leonardo’s contractual position.
Manage budgets, forecasts, estimate at completion, resource demand and financial performance, providing accurate and timely information for decision-making.
Lead reviews, governance and assurance activities, presenting status, evidence, decisions, options and recommendations.
Protect configuration-controlled baselines and understand the relationship between delivery evidence, acceptance, contractual milestones and payment.

Customer leadership and ways of working

Build effective relationships with customers, delivery partners and internal stakeholders in a formal, evidence-led environment.
Negotiate confidently, handle difficult conversations and challenge unrealistic positions or unsupported assumptions while preserving constructive working relationships.
Remain calm, resilient and objective under sustained customer, schedule and delivery pressure.
Hold internal teams, suppliers, partners and customers to agreed commitments, escalating where required.
Adapt rapidly to changing priorities and incomplete information without losing control of the delivery baseline or audit trail.
Drive recovery activity where performance, schedule, acceptance or customer confidence is at risk.
Promote lessons learned, continuous improvement and proportionate delivery discipline across the team.

What You’ll Bring

Proven leadership of complex infrastructure and platform projects, including associated application or technology change, across the full delivery lifecycle.
Demonstrable willingness and ability to produce high-quality project artefacts personally in a matrix environment.
Advanced planning, scheduling, dependency, RAID, change and recovery-management capability.
Practical experience of requirements management, traceability, verification, test planning and customer acceptance.
Strong financial and commercial awareness, including budgeting, forecasting, scope control and delivery against contractual commitments.
Experience managing multiple concurrent deliveries and prioritising constrained specialist resources.
Strong negotiation, influencing, conflict-resolution and written communication skills.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and suppliers without relying solely on direct line authority.
Strong governance and assurance capability, including accurate reporting and maintenance of auditable records.
Evidence of sound judgement, personal resilience and constructive challenge in demanding customer environments.

Desirable

Delivery experience within defence, central government or an equivalent regulated and contractually controlled environment.
Experience of cyber security, security accreditation, secure infrastructure, restricted environments or security-constrained delivery.
Knowledge of IT Service Management, service transition and operational readiness.
Experience managing subcontractors, third-party suppliers and partner organisations.
Experience supporting bids, mobilisation and bid-to-delivery transition.
APM, PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or an equivalent recognised project-management qualification.
MSP or comparable programme-management awareness.

This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). You must also be eligible for National Security Vetting (NSV), which may include Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information, please visit: UK Security Vetting

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance.

Time to Recharge: Generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
Secure your Future: Award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks.
Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 53,000 people worldwide including 8,500 across 9 sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
